title: Reduced-form LOCO model; no expression factors
credit: literature: Fehrmann 2015 [F1], Kang 2008 [K1], Dahl 2019 [D2], Taylor 2018 [T1], Shukla 2020 [S4], Davoli 2013 [D3]
reviewer agents: domain R1 #1-3, statistics R1 #2
one_line: Literature on dosage-driven expression covariance and co-selected arms led to a CN->expression reduced form adjusted for the arm CN of all other chromosomes, with expression PCs deliberately excluded.

title: HCT116 primary; benchmark is hub-dominated
one_line: Data profiling showed that 83% of HEK293T trans hits come from non-expressed perturbations and that 10% of perturbations give >90% of hits, so HCT116 became primary and hub controls became mandatory.

title: Review rebuilds evaluation: arm hold-out, dependence-aware stats, hub baselines, sealed TEST
credit: reviewer agents: AI-failure #1,#2,#4; external PI #2,#6,#11; statistics #5,#9; prior work #2,#3,#4; data #2,#4
one_line: Seven reviewer agents replaced 5 Mb bins with a chromosome-arm hold-out, Fisher p with regulator-label permutation and an arm jackknife, and added the B4e/B5 hub baselines, the S2 sample set and a physical TEST seal.

title: Cis gate, SuSiE-L1 attribution and knockdown sign specified
credit: literature: Goh 2013 MR framing [G2], Burgess & Thompson 2011 [B2], Warmerdam 2026 [W1], SuSiE [W4]
reviewer agents: closed-form Wakefield ABF with L=1 (algorithms #9, not in LITERATURE.md), statistics #6/#8, domain R2 #1, round-3 #1/#3
one_line: The PI's instrument and attribution sketches became a first-stage-F gate, a closed-form SuSiE L=1 posterior with a cis-strength prior, and a shrunk cis sign for predicting knockdown direction.

title: First TRAIN numbers: hub prior beats CN model 12-fold
credit: PI (baselines specified by reviewer agents in TP3)
one_line: M1 reached OR 1.59 (perm p 0.25) while the label-free DepMap hub prior B5 reached 19.7, showing that pooled enrichment on this benchmark is mostly hubness and detectability.

title: Cis-instrument gate is the one large, stable gain
credit: PI (pre-registered greedy tiers, strict adoption rule from external PI R2 #1)
one_line: Under a strict two-fold adoption rule, G1 (F >= 100) gave +0.79 log-OR and A3 gave +0.36. Arm alternatives, G2, transforms and the hinge all failed, leaving TRAIN OR 5.0.

title: No within-regulator target information; context layer split off
credit: prior-work reviewer R1 #5 had proposed the target-expression prior earlier
one_line: Within-regulator AUROC was 0.507. The detectability fusion gained +1.57 log-OR but failed the exact pair-shuffle control, so it ships as a separate HCT116 context layer and the selected method stays CN-only.

title: One sealed TEST run; gate replicates, headline not significant
one_line: On 14 held-out arms the CN-only tool reached OR 3.85 (perm p 0.068, n.s.). The G1 gain replicated (+0.97, CI 0.30-1.64) and the claims were narrowed to: which regulators (weakly), not which targets. A modest-direction claim was later withdrawn (D9, 28 Oct): direction is not established.
